profile_guardian: Guardian consent obtained, used with the guardian present
profile_guardian_note: The consent record (timestamp + agreement version) is stored separately for compliance, apart from the User Agreement tick
profile_logout_body: You will need to sign in again. Your test records and unlocked reports are kept.
profile_soon_desc: Ability reports, test records, membership perks, and the message center are coming
profile_setup_nickname_desc: The nickname appears on grade and share cards — it cannot be skipped.
profile_setup_nickname_rules:
· Required, no default value, duplicates allowed (no uniqueness check)
· At most 12 characters, no leading or trailing spaces
profile_nickname_err_trim: Nickname cannot start or end with spaces
profile_setup_birth_desc: The age band follows automatically; payments gate on the exact birth date for minors.
profile_setup_birth_incomplete: Fill in both birth year and month
profile_setup_band_derived: Age band derived from birth date: {band}
profile_minor_u13: Under 13 — requires guardian consent and accompaniment; identity data stays out of the assessment pool.
profile_minor_u18: Under 18 — assessments work, but paid reports/membership cannot be purchased (re-checked at payment).
profile_setup_games_desc: Pick at least 1. The majority vote sets the default assessment type (FPS / MOBA).
profile_setup_games_custom_desc: Custom games need no category; unclassified picks don't join the vote. Add up to 3, tap × to remove.
profile_setup_games_tie: (FPS and MOBA tied — choose during the assessment)
